description: rimu-ws - a fork of wtx on a thread-per-core io_uring executor (multishot accept and recv into a provided buffer ring). HTTP/1.1 through its Http1ServerFramework: a hand-written resumable request parser and body decoder (Content-Length and chunked) that answer straight out of the receive buffer, a path router with one handler per method, the query parsed on every request, a timed response (the driver awaits an io_uring timer, so a delayed request holds no thread), and a JSON endpoint that serializes the dataset on every request and compresses it by Accept-Encoding (brotli quality 2, else gzip, else none; nothing cached). A second listener on 8081 serves HTTP/1.1 over TLS (user-space TLS 1.3 from the mounted certificate, ALPN http/1.1 only): the same JSON uncompressed, and POST /echo, which answers with the body the parser decoded (Content-Length or chunked) byte for byte. No spin: the runtimes sleep as soon as the ring is empty.
